findings.label: Open redirect via login callbackUrl
findings.issue: /login reads callbackUrl from the query string and calls router.push(callbackUrl) after a successful sign-in with no same-origin check, so a crafted /login?callbackUrl=https://evil.com can bounce a legitimately authenticated user off-site.
findings.action: Validate that callbackUrl starts with a single '/' and not '//' before using it, or drop the parameter.

findings.label: Stale JWT after role change or deactivation
findings.issue: The JWT strategy stamps role at sign-in and never re-reads isActive/role from the DB, so the proxy and server actions enforce against the token. A user demoted from ADMIN to EXECUTIVE, or deactivated, keeps their old access until the token expires or they re-login.
findings.action: Re-check isActive/role against the DB in the server actions (or a shared guard), shorten the JWT maxAge, or move to database sessions.

findings.label: Client-side Zod only on auth forms
findings.issue: The brief says all inputs are Zod-validated on client and server. Login and change-password run Zod client-side, but the equipment/member/loan create dialogs use native 'required' plus manual checks and rely on the server actions' Zod. Server enforcement is complete, so there is no security gap, but client Zod is inconsistent with the brief's wording.
findings.action: Extend client Zod to the CRUD dialogs, or record the scoping decision (auth inputs only) in ASSUMPTIONS.md.

findings.label: activateUserAction bypasses the service layer
findings.issue: activateUserAction calls prisma.user.update directly while its siblings (deactivate, resetPassword, changeRole) go through user.service.ts, against the AGENTS.md service-layer convention.
findings.action: Move the activate logic into user.service.ts.

findings.label: Auth type casts and beta dependency
findings.issue: auth.ts casts (user as { role: string }) and (session.user as { role: string }) despite the next-auth.d.ts augmentation making session.user.role a string, and next-auth is pinned to a ^5.0.0-beta.32 caret range.
findings.action: Drop the redundant casts and consider pinning next-auth/bcryptjs to exact versions per the AGENTS.md dependency guidance.
